title: Folded single-tick capacity propagation and three-state execution gate

changes.change: New migration 20261114_008_single_tick_capacity_schema adds single_tick_capacity_anchor_raw and single_tick_capacity_binding_pool_id to manager_v4_closed_loops, manager_v4_reviews, manager_v4_review_broadcast_requests and manager_cow_execution_attempts.
The folded single-tick capacity (M_cap) is computed once and published on the closed-loop row together with the binding hop. It is no longer used as a filter and discarded.

The final gate enforces amount_in <= M_cap and fail-closes when no folded capacity is published. A new three-state execution gate classifies every hop as favorable, unchanged, adverse or fatal using pool_manager::state_transition.
The broadcast attempt carries the reviewed folded capacity so the amount that was broadcast can be proven against the bound the review established.
The Python task config publishes the folded capacity as maxProbeAmountRaw and singleTickCapacityRaw. The Rust ladder prefers singleTickCapacityRaw over maxProbeAmountRaw and records the basis.

failClosed: No published folded capacity blocks the route with single_tick_capacity_unavailable.
A final input above the folded capacity blocks the route with final_input_exceeds_single_tick_capacity.
An adverse market move blocks the route with the stable reason adverse_price_move.
A price that left the expected tick range is fatal.
A missing expected or current pool state blocks the route.
remaining: The bounded sqrtPriceLimitX96 is not yet written into the production broadcast payload.
The on-chain contract does not yet read the current pool state and re-verify the three-state transition.
Batch isolation for a single failing closed loop is not yet proven end to end.
Chain and off-chain parity for the final three-hop input amount is not yet recorded.
The production broadcast switch remains disabled; no production database was written.
